import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { oauthOpenidRequests } from "../../../backend/schema/oauth_openid_requests";

export const oauthOpenidRequestsCms = customizeTable<typeof oauthOpenidRequests>("oauth_openid_requests", {
    hideFromNavigation: true,
    display: {
        title: "nonce"
    },
    fields: {
        nonce: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["id", "nonce", "accessGrant"]
});
